sets.name: Deep strokes (the bells at the big arrivals)
sets.why: The deepest ff strokes after the C1 pulse: the opening bells answering at each big arrival. One set, one short clip per stroke.
sets.rule: pack notes midi <= 40 within 80 ms of the strokes at 79.92, 134.22, 407.45, 475.18 and 616.04 s
sets.section: A', T, Climax, A'' cont., Coda I

sets.name: Final chords, the bass
sets.why: The low octaves of the four last chords: the bells close the frame.
sets.rule: pack notes midi <= 43 in 694.7-697 s

sets.name: Piano run into A' (Bb2 to F4)
sets.why: The run that launches the strings' rise (76.1 s).
sets.rule: top of each roll piano cluster 76.0-77.85 s

sets.name: Falling run after the recap's rise (F5 to C3)
sets.why: The run that answers the deep stroke at 475.2 s.
sets.rule: pack, top of each cluster 477.9-479.5 s

sets.name: Theme 2 continued, B2 (piano)
sets.why: The piano carries theme 2 on after the head, up to Eb5 at 198.3 s.
sets.rule: skyline of all roll notes 187-200.3 s at midi >= 60, minDur 0.3

sets.name: Theme 2, the strings take the line (B2)
sets.why: The strings take the line and it opens out (208-216 s), climbing to B5 at 221.7 s, into the climax.
sets.rule: skyline of all roll notes 200.3-222 s at midi >= 60, minDur 0.3

sets.name: Development opens: the piano's accents
sets.why: The dense figuration of D1, only its hardest strokes.
sets.rule: top note of roll piano clusters 298-321.5 s whose loudest note is >= 90

sets.name: Coda I: the high piano
sets.why: After the sweep, the high piano with the winds: points of light, as in the close and the meno mosso.
sets.rule: skyline of roll piano notes 618.5-643.5 s at midi >= 79, minDur 0.2

sets.name: Coda II: the drive begins
sets.why: The steady figuration of Coda II, its firmer strokes, before the last crescendo.
sets.rule: top note of roll piano clusters 656-680 s whose loudest note is >= 65

sets.name: Thread: the bass line (piano and low strings)
sets.why: The bells thread: the bass under everything, dim between the deep strokes.
sets.rule: lowest pack note of each cluster at midi <= 45, plus roll low-string/bassoon notes at midi <= 50 (minDur 0.2); one per 0.3 s, the loudest

sets.name: Thread: the inner strings (violas, cellos in the tenor)
sets.why: Theme 1 thread: the inner string voice between the statements.
sets.rule: skyline of roll Viola, Cello at midi >= 50 and String Ensemble at midi 50-67, minDur 0.25

sets.name: Thread: the violins
sets.why: Theme 2 thread: the high strings passing its shape around; split into phrases for Ivory by build-show.ts.
sets.rule: skyline of roll Violin and String Ensemble at midi >= 66, minDur 0.25

sets.name: Thread: the highest piano voice
sets.why: Points of light, dim, between the high passages.
sets.rule: skyline of roll piano notes at midi >= 76, minDur 0.12, one per 0.2 s

sets.name: Thread: the piano accompaniment figures
sets.why: The drive of the piano at every speed.
sets.rule: for each roll piano cluster, its lowest note at midi 48-74; one per 0.14 s, the loudest

sets.name: Thread: every accent
sets.why: The chord blocks as small dry bursts.
sets.rule: top note of every roll cluster whose loudest note is >= 92; one per 0.25 s

sets.name: Thread: the winds (clarinet, oboe, horn, bassoon, flute)
sets.why: The lone wind voice, wherever a wind plays.
sets.rule: skyline of wind-family roll notes, minDur 0.2

sets.name: Thread: the piano runs
sets.why: Gliss wherever the piano runs.
sets.rule: runs of >= 7 roll piano cluster tops, each <= 0.14 s and <= 9 semitones after the last, >= 65 % one way, spanning >= 10 semitones
